context: Two teens compare summer fair plans after school
purpose: Teach: ビニール/オート/懸賞/近辺/カーブ/貝/ニッポン/プロフェッショナル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、今週の土曜って駅近辺の夏祭り行く？
lines.en: Hey Riku, are you going to the summer festival near the station this Saturday?
lines.style: Casual teen question with a friendly, inviting tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: もちろん行くよ。父さんのオートバイの後ろに乗せてもらって早めに着く予定。
lines.en: Of course I'm going. My dad's giving me a ride on the back of his motorcycle so I'll get there early.
lines.style: Enthusiastic teen reply sharing transportation plans casually.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいなー。私は懸賞コーナー狙ってるんだ、去年三等で大きいぬいぐるみ当てた子いたらしいよ。
lines.en: Lucky! I'm aiming for the raffle booth, apparently some kid won a huge stuffed animal as third prize last year.
lines.style: Slightly envious teen then sharing excitement about prizes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジか。そういえば神社前の道、急カーブのとこに新しい射的の店出るって聞いたよ。
lines.en: Seriously? Speaking of which, I heard a new shooting gallery is opening near the sharp curve on the road in front of the shrine.
lines.style: Surprised teen reaction smoothly transitioning to fresh local info.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、知ってる！その近くで焼き貝の屋台もやるらしくて、地元のおじさんがニッポン代表のユニフォーム着て焼いてるんだって。
lines.en: Oh, I know! There's a grilled shellfish stall around there too, and the local guy running it wears a Japan national team jersey while he grills.
lines.style: Animated teen sharing detailed local gossip with vivid imagery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それ完全にプロフェッショナルの仕事じゃん、毎年同じ場所守ってるのほんと尊敬するわ。
lines.en: That's totally a professional's work, I really respect how he holds the same spot every year.
lines.style: Admiring teen tone with casual slang and genuine respect.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でしょ？あ、それと雨降りそうだから透明のビニール傘持ってった方がいいかもね。
lines.en: Right? Oh, and since it looks like rain, we should probably bring clear vinyl umbrellas.
lines.style: Practical teen suggestion adding weather concern naturally.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解、じゃあ六時に神社の前で集合ってことでいい？
lines.en: Got it, so let's meet in front of the shrine at six, sound good?
lines.style: Easygoing teen confirming plans in a relaxed manner.
